newsitem.title: USA: Tristar sees profitable Q1 from new sales.
newsitem.headline: Tristar sees profitable Q1 from new sales.

text.p: Tristar Corp said Friday that it expects a profitable first quarter as a result of sales from the successful introduction of its new Royal Selections fragrance line in September.

"This new line provided strong underpinnings for the wholesale segment in the first quarter which will, when combined with the other segments, translate into near record quarterly sales for the company," Tristar said in a release.
On Friday Tristar reported a fourth quarter net loss of $6.6 million or $0.40 per share, compared with a $1.4 million or $0.08 per share net loss in the 1995 quarter.
The 1996 fourth quarter loss included the write-down of deferred tax assets of $3.9 million, Tristar said.
